item.title: Top Pick: Shake Shack: Free Small Lemonade with Any Sandwich or Burger (Code FREESIP)
item.guid: Shake Shack-Free Small Lemonade with Any Sandwich or-2026-08-23
item.description: Add a Small Lemonade and any Sandwich or Burger to your cart and enter code FREESIP at checkout via the Shake Shack app, kiosk, or shakeshack.com; offer valid August 20-23, 2026 at participating locations, today is the last day. (Through August 23, 2026)

item.title: Top Pick: Panera Bread: BOGO $5 Entree: Code BOGO5
item.description: Buy one full-price entree (soups, salads, or sandwiches) and get a second entree for just $5 using promo code BOGO5 at checkout on panerabread.com or in the Panera app; requires a free MyPanera account and works at most but not all locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Top Pick: Chili's: 3 For Me Meal from $10.99
item.description: Get a bottomless non-alcoholic drink, a starter (chips and salsa, soup, or side salad), and a full-size entree all for one flat price starting at $10.99; available all day for dine-in or pickup at participating locations. (Ongoing)

item.title: Subway: 6-Inch Sub + Chips + Drink for $6.99
item.description: Get the featured 6-inch sub of the day bundled with chips or a cookie and a drink for $6.99 every day at participating Subway locations; check the Subway app or website for your location's featured sub. (Ongoing)

item.title: Noodles and Company: Delicious Duo: Entree and Side from $9.95
